purpose: Single authoritative source for Step5b live-contact LOCKED defaults and OPEN authorization gates. LOCKED values MUST NOT be re-asked of the user; reopen one only on explicit user instruction. Read by tools/step5b_authorization_status.py.

locked.note: Settled Step5b live-contact defaults. Do not re-ask the user. These are data the agent must hold, not open questions.
locked.route_policy: The Step5b live-contact route is LOCKED to ros2_remote_control_headless. TP/bridge (tp_bridge_step5b_v1) is archive/reference evidence only and is NOT a selectable Step5b live route. If no ROS2 Remote Control/headless live runner exists yet, the correct outcome is no live Step5b run (build the ROS2 runner), NOT a TP/bridge fallback. Reopening this route requires explicit user instruction.
locked.params_note: Step5b textbook parameters (target_force_n, contact latch, guards) are authoritative in the files above and echoed by the readiness summary's step5b_textbook_parameters. Do not copy the numbers here.
locked.user_step5b_contact_authorization_note: User has authorized ENTERING Step5b contact in principle. Do not re-ask whether to do Step5b. This is not a per-run final trigger (see open_gates.operator_final_trigger_received) and does not by itself authorize motion.
locked.legacy_note: Legacy bridge+TP Step5b is retained reference/textbook, not the active execution route. Do not silently revive it as the live route.

open_gates.note: The only items still open before Step5b live contact. Discuss these with the user; do not re-ask the LOCKED defaults (including the already-given user_step5b_contact_authorization).

live_runner_auditor_accepted.derived_from: config/step5b_live_runner_acceptance.json (accepted==true AND a live_runner_entrypoint that exists and compiles AND live_runner_route == locked.route)
